resources.string: Reads Japanese text in the game on screen, and in other apps when you ask, so a word can be looked up and made into an Anki card. Password fields are never read. Pictures of the screen stay on this device.
Today\'s reading time, characters and cards against your daily goals, as rings
The week\'s reading time and a bar for each day, with your daily goal
A day you played, from a month or a year ago, with its picture and what you wrote
Play a game today, and it shows here once it is a memory.
